_about: Where each sampled instrument of meloet comes from, so the same files can be fetched again (docs/architecture.md 19-1).
One entry per source. fetch: how to get the exact same bytes (a tarball with its sha256, or a git commit with sparse-checkout paths).

use: which files we take (paths relative to the source root; '*' and '**' are glob patterns), or, for Naked Drums whose file names do not say which drum they are, an SFZ selection that tools/sounds/sfz_select.py resolves.
attribution: what a credit needs (CC BY 3.0 4(b) / CC BY 4.0 3(a)): creator, title, source URI, license URI. CC0 entries keep a credit too, because the authors ask for one (not required).
license_copies: the license and readme texts that came with the source, copied without change.

use.note: This takes every mic for 11 sounds plus all 5 toms and both closed hi-hats (Tight, Closed), so the choice of toms and mics can still be made.
